avis.titre: Suggest for an airless pump for the packaging
avis.texte: I've been using your Vitamin C 13% Serum and absolutely love it. It's perfect for daily use compared to the 23% one. I just wanted to suggest maybe using an airless pump bottle for the packaging. It would help prevent oxidation and make it super convenient to use (like Benton's CE Ferulic serum). Especially for people like me who tend to forget to put the serum into the fridge when I'm busy in the morning. It could also be amazing if the formula included ferulic acid (1311 with Vitamin C, E, and ferulic) plus some antioxidants like CoQ10 and glutathione to boost stability and results. Thanks for always making great products! 💛
